title: this is the last time
summary:
JEAN VICQUEMARE — Jean looks over at you as you limp outside to join him. He takes a long drag of his cigarette.
ELECTROCHEMISTRY [Trivial: Success] — Ask him for a hit. Just one. He can’t say no to you after you got shot. If he said no he’d be a hypocrite. Worst case you have to beg him a little. No shame in that.
YOU — “Can I—”
JEAN VICQUEMARE — He hands you the cigarette wordlessly and lets smoke spiral out of his mouth. He flicks his lighter on and lights it for you as you put it to your lips. “So, you want a drink?”
(Outside of Precinct 41, after everything, Harry tries to figure out what he and Jean were to each other)
